PJA 0.6.1 (tag v0.6.1, commit 3488d96), https://github.com/YadeWira/PJA,
from the vendor tarball pja-0.6.1-zpaqstd.tar.gz of its release (sha256
48b520f86c2d83a92ba94cd3391bc29032bb627f3a7445e5f4aee8ff8fa83a47, as its
SHA256SUMS says), copied unmodified, as zpaq-std vendors it. 0.6.1 writes
the same streams as 0.6.0; only its build changes (clang ~8% faster, with
-fno-builtin).

PPA uses it for the JPEG inside a JNG (its JDAT, and JDAA for the alpha):
pjacodec.Compress with version 7's model, pjacodec.Decompress. MIT
(LICENSE); NOTICE has PJA's third-party notes (IJG for arithmetic-coded
JPEG, CharLS for JPEG-LS).

Do not patch these files here: changes go to the PJA repository, and a new
release tag comes in whole, replacing this directory.
